pipeline: Own reference -> GEM-X SOMA77 control; no MotionBricks inference
ground_policy: One constant whole-avatar vertical offset places the first pose lowest skinned vertex 15 mm above the floor. No per-frame grounding, no foot locks, no limb stretching. Later penetration and hovering are retained and measured, not silently repaired.

validation.angular_metrics_note: Shortest-arc local joint rotation differences at30Hz, active action only. Engineered neutral holds excluded. Angular acceleration is a kinematic diagnostic, not measured torque or proof of visual smoothness. Generated timing differs from source timing.

limitations: Full skin checked8Hz, not continuous collision proof
No physical balance, self-collision or hand/foot contact guarantee

Visible penetrations/hovering intentionally retained instead of framewise grounding

provenance.pipeline: Own reference -> GEM-X SOMA77 control; no MotionBricks inference
provenance.source_space: Y up, metres; source first heading removed and origin/floor translated once
provenance.surface_bounds_note: Joint-coordinate bounds only, not recovered or target skinned geometry. Do not use as full-skin ground proof.
limitations: Monocular depth and hidden joints remain estimates
No source video, source frames or model weights published
Non-model fingers stay at reference during neural output; source finger articulation is not regenerated
provenance.loop_policy: Original full source motion; not closed

basis.exclusion_note: Gorilla uses the explicitly reported reliable prefix before >=5 major projected joints leave image; original raw/cleaned controls remain full length. Coverage is not accuracy.
basis.key_policy: Greedy largest body-trajectory deviation from piecewise linear paths, seven landmarks with >=8-frame spacing, using head/hands/feet/shins/root; corrected by modest smoothing, no authored source poses.

cleaning.quaternion_filter: Sign-continuous local quaternion normalized Gaussian average

basis.default_stance: Authored relaxed T-bind delta: upper arms ±75deg worldZ, thighs -4deg/shins +4deg worldX, feet reference orientation; reference-proportioned hips height. Not recovered performance or neural generation.

limitations: Monocular depth and hidden joints remain estimates
No source video, source frames or model weights published

Target proportions differ from the performer
A constant first-pose ground calibration does not establish later support: visible hovering or penetration can remain
No hand/foot pinning or armor self-collision solve
Fingers remain at original rig rest pose; source hand detail is not reproduced
